title: Receive sample
purpose: Receive one physical sample and a single container while creating its chain of custody at the same time. Use an existing order’s receipt page for multiple containers or continued receipt.
summary: Receive one physical sample with a single container, creating its chain of custody at the same time.

tasks.title: Receive the sample
steps: Choose the [[Project]] and enter the [[Chain of custody reference]] and [[Client sample ID]].
Enter the collection details, [[Received at]], [[Cooler temperature]] and the inspection fields.
Choose the [[Tests]] and select [[Receive sample]]. The sample gets its laboratory ID.

tasks.title: Record a problem found at receipt
steps: Choose the [[Disposition]] and explain it in [[Disposition note]].

good_to_know: This always creates a new chain of custody. For several containers, or more samples on one order, receive them from the chain of custody instead.
Record the cooler temperature exactly as read. It is never rounded.
Holding clocks start at the collection time, or the composite end, not at receipt.
If anything is invalid, nothing is saved. Your entries stay on the form.

sections.title: Chain of custody
paragraphs: The order created here takes the project’s standing purchase order when it has one and starts with Standard turnaround. Add or change the purchase order, turnaround, shipment details and instructions afterwards with Edit details on the chain of custody. Project and chain-of-custody instructions are shown on the order receipt page, not on this form.

items.label: Project
items.description: Required active project with an active client.

items.label: Chain of custody reference
items.description: Required reference, up to 120 characters. This path creates a new order rather than choosing an existing order with the same text.

items.label: Client sample ID
items.description: Required client identifier, up to 120 characters; it is separate from the generated laboratory ID.

items.label: Sample type
items.description: List: Field sample (initially), Field duplicate, Field blank, Trip blank or Equipment / rinsate blank. The field designation written on the chain of custody. Laboratory QC samples prepared in the laboratory belong to analytical batches, not here.

items.label: Collection type
items.description: Required Grab or Composite, initially Grab.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Required Water, Wastewater or Soil; chosen tests must match it.

items.label: Sample source
items.description: Optional list grouped by matrix, with Not recorded first. Water: Drinking water, Groundwater, Surface water, Stormwater. Wastewater: Wastewater influent, Wastewater effluent, Industrial wastewater, Stormwater. Soil: Soil, Sediment, Sludge / biosolids, Solid waste. What was sampled, within the matrix. It must belong to the chosen matrix; otherwise the form refuses it with a message to choose another source or correct the matrix.

items.label: Collector name
items.description: Required collector, up to 160 characters.

items.label: Composite started at
items.description: Optional for grab receipt; required for a composite and must not follow its end.

items.label: Collected / composite ended at
items.description: Required collection time or composite end. It cannot follow receipt. Holding clocks use collection or composite end rather than order creation.

items.label: Collection location
items.description: Required specific collection place, up to 200 characters.

items.label: Sample remarks
items.description: Optional multi-line text: appearance, odor, hazards or field readings noted on the chain of custody.

sections.title: Receipt inspection and disposition
paragraphs: The pick-lists are starter vocabularies of common values, not requirements of any method or regulation; Other… accepts any text, and values recorded before a list existed still display. They do not check a container or preservative against any method’s requirements.

items.label: Received at
items.description: Required actual receipt time in laboratory local time, no earlier than collection and no later than now. The signed-in operator is recorded as Received by.

items.label: Relinquished by
items.description: Required name of the delivering custodian, up to 160 characters, as signed on the chain of custody.

items.label: Cooler temperature
items.description: Required exact finite decimal reading, up to three decimal places in a seven-digit field; it is never rounded. Original entered reading text is also retained. Receipt applies no universal pass/fail temperature threshold; test-specific screening appears later. Entered in °C (the field's unit).

items.label: Thermometer
items.description: Optional thermometer or IR gun used for the reading, up to 160 characters. Free text with suggestions: in-service equipment whose type contains the word thermometer (shown as asset ID and name), then instruments typed on earlier receipts. You may type any value.

items.label: Coolant on arrival
items.description: List: Select…, Wet ice, Ice packs, Dry ice or None. Required on every new receipt. Records how the shipment arrived cold; it is separate from the temperature reading and carries no pass/fail rule.

items.label: Custody seal
items.description: Required list: Select…, Intact, Broken or damaged, No seal present or Other…. Other… reveals a text box (Describe); the text you type is stored as the value. Up to 160 characters. Older free-text values display as Other with their text.

items.label: Preservation check
items.description: Required list: Select…, Preservation verified at receipt, Preserved per labels, not verified, No chemical preservation required, Preserved by the laboratory at receipt, Preservation incorrect or missing, Not checked or Other…. Other… reveals a text box (Describe); the text you type is stored as the value. Up to 200 characters. It is distinct from container-specific preservation and later method-specific assessment.

items.label: Container type
items.description: Required list for the single container: Select…, ten common vial, bottle and jar types (for example 40 mL VOA vial, 1 L plastic (HDPE), 1 L amber glass, 8 oz glass jar) or Other…. Up to 160 characters.

items.label: Container condition
items.description: Required list: Select…, Intact, Leaking, Broken or cracked, Lid loose, Headspace or bubbles, Insufficient volume, Label missing or illegible or Other…. Up to 160 characters. This path has no separate container preservative input.

items.label: Storage location
items.description: Required location at initial receipt, up to 160 characters; it becomes the destination of the initial custody event. Free text with suggestions from storage locations already recorded on samples, so one place is spelled one way.

items.label: Discrepancy
items.description: Optional free text describing anything that differs from the chain of custody or labels. If entered, a disposition note is required.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Required Proceed, Qualify, Hold or Reject, initially Proceed. A decision other than Proceed requires a note. This is a receipt decision rather than an analysis result.

items.label: Disposition note
items.description: Optional for Proceed without a discrepancy; otherwise required to explain the decision. Stored with receipt provenance.

items.label: Tests
items.description: Select at least one active definition whose method version is active and matrix matches the sample. Labels show analyte, method code/version, unit and matrix. New receipt rechecks eligibility.

items.label: Search analyte, method or unit
items.description: Enhanced picker searches analyte, method code, version and unit. Enter adds the highlighted option; Backspace removes the last selected option and Left arrow moves to earlier selections. A native multiple select remains available without enhancement.

items.label: Matrix changes / Remove this test
items.description: Changing Matrix keeps selections for review instead of deleting them. Mismatched options are marked and listed; remove them individually or with the mismatch removal action, or correct Matrix. Submission refuses incompatible tests while preserving choices.

sections.title: Actions and recorded outcome
paragraphs: The system assigns a unique laboratory accession and container label; numbering gaps can occur and IDs are not reused. A validation or audit failure leaves no partial receipt. Dates/times use the configured laboratory zone; invalid fields are shown with entered values.

items.label: Receive sample
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators create the order, sample, requested tests, one labeled container, initial custody event and audit together, then open the sample record.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to Samples without saving.
